HELP_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION_MAIN: Displays help information and provides a way to get debug info.
HELP_COMMAND.TITLE: Scryarc Help & Support
HELP_COMMAND.DESCRIPTION: Welcome to Scryarc, your TTRPG Server Architect! Here are some resources to get you started.
HELP_COMMAND.CMD_NEW_GAME: Starts the process to create a new game space on this server.
HELP_COMMAND.CMD_CONFIG: *(Admin Only)* Configures all bot settings for this server.
HELP_COMMAND.CMD_ARCHIVE_GAME: *(Admin/GM Only)* Archives a completed game to free up an active slot.
HELP_COMMAND.BUG_REPORT_INSTRUCTION: If you encounter an issue, you can get pre-formatted debug info to include in your report. Click the button below!
HELP_COMMAND.DEBUG_DM_DESCRIPTION: Please copy the entire block of text below and include it in your bug report or support request. This information is crucial for helping us troubleshoot your issue.
HELP_COMMAND.DEBUG_DM_SUCCESS: ✅ I have sent the debug information to your DMs!
HELP_COMMAND.DEBUG_DM_FAIL: ❌ I could not send you a DM. Please check your privacy settings to allow Direct Messages from server members.

GAME_MANAGER.GM_NOT_FOUND: Game Master not found in server
GAME_MANAGER.GM_INSTRUCTIONS_CONTENT:
• Use Discord's built-in permissions to invite players
• You have special permissions in this channel
• Archive the game when finished using server commands
• Need help? Contact server administrators

Good luck with your campaign! 🎉

GAME_MANAGER.BOT_HIERARCHY_TOO_LOW: I cannot create or manage roles/permissions because my highest role is too low in the Discord role hierarchy. Please ensure my highest role is above any roles I need to manage or apply permissions to. Reason: {reason}
GAME_MANAGER.BOT_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: Could not find bot's member object in the guild. This is required for permission management.
GAME_MANAGER.CATEGORY_CREATION_FAILED: Failed to create a new category for the game channels. Please check bot permissions. Reason: {reason}
GAME_MANAGER.BOT_MISSING_MANAGE_CHANNELS: I am missing the 'Manage Channels' permission at the server level. Please grant me this permission in server settings to create channels.
